title: Eternal  Script BEST AUTOPARRY
script:
local API_URL = "https://el.eternalhub.uk/verify"
local LICENSE_KEY = " your key here "

local HWID = game:GetService("RbxAnalyticsService"):GetClientId()

local function fetchScript()
    local url = API_URL .. "?key=" .. LICENSE_KEY .. "&hwid=" .. HWID
    local success, response = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, url)

    if not success then
        return nil, "Connection failed: " .. tostring(response)
    end

    local errors = {
        ["Invalid or unredeemed key"] = "Access Denied: Redeem your key in Discord first.",
        ["HWID does not match"]       = "Access Denied: HWID mismatch. Reset if needed.",
        ["Missing key or hwid"]       = "Error: Missing parameters in request.",
    }

    local msg = errors[response]
    if msg then
        return nil, msg
    end

    return response, nil
end

local scriptContent, err = fetchScript()

if not scriptContent then
    warn(err)
    return
end

local fn, compileErr = loadstring(scriptContent)
if not fn then
    warn("Execution Error: " .. tostring(compileErr))
    return
end

print("Authentication Successful! Loading Eternal Bending...")
fn()

A cooldown tracker at the bottom of your screen displays every move currently on cooldown. Each move is color-coded by element, turns red as it becomes available, and displays READY the moment it's usable again.

In-Combat Only

Only shows ESP for the player you're currently fighting, keeping crowded servers much cleaner.
New Legit Tab
Failure Simulation

Designed to make parries appear less robotic.

Four independent chances can be configured:

Miss Rate
Dash Instead Rate
Mistime Rate (80–170ms late)
Ignore Rate

Facing Checks

Additional conditions can be enabled:

Require Self Facing
Require Enemy Facing
Adjustable Facing Cone

These work independently of Failure Simulation.

AoE attacks automatically ignore the enemy-facing requirement since direction doesn't matter for those.
